from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
progdir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545201/attempts/077c639e3ede471faa305f8b7291dc1f/system/state/workspace/programs')
progdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    divider = grid[sep_rows[0]][0] if sep_rows else grid[0][sep_cols[0]]
    rows = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    cols = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    bg_counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != divider)
    background = bg_counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker_counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != divider and v != background)
    marker = marker_counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = []
    for ri in range(len(rows) - 1):
        y0, y1 = rows[ri] + 1, rows[ri + 1]
        outrow = []
        for ci in range(len(cols) - 1):
            x0, x1 = cols[ci] + 1, cols[ci + 1]
            n = sum(grid[y][x] == marker for y in range(y0, y1) for x in range(x0, x1))
            outrow.append(1 if n == 2 else background)
        out.append(outrow)
    return out
'''
path=progdir/'task-2f0c077f.py'
path.write_text(source)
print(path)
